- **P-line** (Planing): turns raw logs into Planks. Has `B_P` planks remaining on its current commission.
- **H-line** (Joinery): turns raw logs into Hinges. Has `B_H` hinges remaining.

Both draw from one shared crew pool. Per tick, the foreman assigns crew: `p` crew to P, `h` crew to H. Crew productivity differs: one P-crew makes `K_P` planks/tick, one H-crew makes `K_H` hinges/tick. World constant `m = K_H/K_P` (H-work is `m`× as fast per head). Empty chairs = idle crew slots; the guild's ideal is that both commissions complete on the same tick so no chair sits empty while the other line still runs (waste).

Given backlogs B_P, B_H, the fair split ratio of crew is q* = m·B_P/B_H heads-on-P per head-on-H. Wait check: finish together ⇒ K_P·p·T = B_P and K_H·h·T = B_H ⇒ p/h = (B_P/K_P)/(B_H/K_H) = (K_H·B_P)/(K_P·B_H) = m·B_P/B_H. Yes! q* = p*/h* is the required crew ratio.
